## `setup_github`

*Available in [Python](#setup_github-python)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Function to guide users through setting up cidatools GitHub integration.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    setup_github(
        force_pat=True
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `force_pat` (`bool`) - If set, will force creation of a PAT even if Git Credential Manager is installed.

    <h4>Returns `None`</h4>

    *No return value*
